comment: fx_distortion, 12 dB of drive, half clip half tanh, -6 dB out, fully wet, ALL FOUR SHELVES TAKEN OUT OF THE COMPARISON. The shelf gains are -200 and not 0 because of plan section 5.13 defect P2: the prototype converts the gain from dB twice, so a nominal 0 dB shelf really applies +1.00 dB. The mapping converts for you by default (set options.shelfGainNominal true to see the raw knob-for-knob difference instead), but -200 goes further and makes the shelves the identity on BOTH sides, which also removes defect P1 - the alpha bug, which nothing can undo from the Max end. The corners are inside our ranges (20..2000 and 1000..20000) so nothing is clamped. waveform is a per cent of the HARD CLIPPER and our effectDistShape runs the other way - the mapping inverts it for you.
